settings.oauthCredsHint: Password must be at least 4 characters; stored locally as a hash only
settings.oauthFlowSteps:
1. Authorize    open {base}/oauth/authorize?response_type=code
                              &client_id=my-app&redirect_uri=http://localhost:PORT/callback
                              &state=xyz&code_challenge=<S256>&code_challenge_method=S256
2. Login        after sign-in the browser redirects to redirect_uri with ?code=...&state=...
3. Token        POST {base}/oauth/token (form-encoded)
                              grant_type=authorization_code & code=<step 2> & code_verifier=<random>
                              & client_id=my-app & redirect_uri=<same>
4. Call API     Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
